patterns: AI search becomes the new Google My Business: gregisenberg 'openai just let every business claim a profile inside chatgpt' (333.5K, 4,702 bookmarks, most bookmarked of the day) calls it the GMB moment for AI and the biggest safe post today.

Model-war follow-through: Fable 5.2 aftershocks plus Gemini 4 Carbon. gregisenberg's 12 prompts to make money with Fable 5.2 (60.9K, 949 bookmarks) and 7-day Gemini 4 Carbon notes (44.4K); emollick on Fable 5.2 above the benchmark trendline (97.3K) and 'Google is back in the race' (40.4K, 34.8K); CodeByPoonam 'Gemini 4 Carbon paints Sundar Pichai' (17.2K).

Prompting got simpler: petergyang 'my prompts went from structured instructions to "ok do it now i believe in you"' (17.0K); his meme-making question (288.7K, 1,672 bookmarks) and kart racer built in 3 prompts (14.9K).
Lean beats fancy: levelsio on moving from expensive PaaS to a cheap VPS (164.6K, 3,590 bookmarks).
Play as proof: AI-built games and worlds (emollick's Dread & District transport sim, 16.6K; petergyang's kart racer from his 8-year-old's drawings, 6.0K).

Calm and family still pull: businessbarista 'great entrepreneur and even greater parent' (12.1K); dickiebush 'you aren't short on ideas, you're short on silence' (7.4K); gregisenberg's social media problems list (11.8K).
Recurring words today: claim your profile, ChatGPT, Gemini 4 Carbon, Fable 5.2, prompts, lean, VPS, memes, games, silence, parent.

indochina_ai.title: Prime Minister's Decision 2146/QD-TTg picks 10 universities (incl. VNU Hanoi UET, VNU-HCM, Hanoi University of Science and Technology, Da Nang UT, UEH, PTIT, Vietnamese-German University) to become advanced AI training centres for 2026-2030, aiming to train at least 10,000 learners in AI, AI+X and X+AI programmes, including at least 600 PhD candidates

FPT, Airbus-owned Skywise and Vietnam Airlines sign an MoU to explore AI for airline operations (fleet reliability, maintenance planning, disruption management) and set up a joint Aviation AI Lab; a first workshop will pick up to four use cases

Fortal Entertainment launches Fortal Studio (AI images, characters, scenes, video, sound), the SiamSun vertical-series app that adapts licensed Thai novels with AI-assisted production, and original film Siam Narukal; actors Pete Thongchua and Jack Blackjack licensed their likeness for AI actors

Trending on X 10 Nov: Ipsos AI Monitor 2026 shows Asia leads AI excitement; in Thailand 77% are excited and 61% nervous about AI, 80% of employed Thais say AI saved them time at work (62% globally), but only 47% trust companies using AI to protect personal data and 35% find AI chatbots trustworthy
indochina_ai.source: Ipsos (survey fielded 20 Mar-3 Apr 2026; resurfaced on X 10 Nov)
